about_the_game:
Kasane Teto Finally Arrives on Desktop Mate!

Responding to passionate requests from the Steam community and inquiries for "Kasane Teto implementation," we are thrilled to announce that Kasane Teto is now available as DLC for Desktop Mate! Enjoy a new desktop experience with Kasane Teto, unique to Desktop Mate.

  • Beautiful Graphics and Natural Movement with the Latest 3D Technology

  • New 3D Model and Exclusive Motions Created Specifically for Desktop Mate

  • Exclusive Voices Using VOICEPEAK Kasane Teto

* Desktop Mate is required to use this content. Please update to the latest version before use. * Usage of this content is subject to the Kasane Teto Character Usage Guidelines.

* According to this license, this content may be used for video distribution on platforms such as YouTube, NicoNico Douga, and Twitch.

* The recorded voices for Kasane Teto in this DLC use VOICEPEAK Kasane Teto.

Contents included in this product

Kasane Teto
